question: Who among the following received the MS Subbulakshmi Award from the Tamil Nadu Eyal Isai Nataka Manram for the year 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vani **__**__Jairam__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Madurai Indian Carnatic singer **Shanmukhavadivu Subbulakshmi** was born in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, on September 16, 1916, and passed away on December 11, 2004.
 
• She was the first musician to ever receive India's highest civilian honor, the Bharat Ratna.
 
• Some of the most prominent and revered honors were bestowed upon Subbulakshmi, including the Padma Bhushan in 1954, the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1956, and the Sangeetha Kalanidhi in 1968.
 
• She received the **Ramon Magsaysay Award in 1974**.
